ce_016_new.lesson: Before proposing to measure a specific component of a multi-force system, test whether that component is MATHEMATICALLY IDENTIFIABLE from available observables. Causal independence (CE-013) is necessary but not sufficient. If the force equation has N unknown components and observables provide fewer than N independent equations, the target component cannot be uniquely estimated even with perfect sensors. Replace CE-013 causal independence with identifiability test for multi-component force systems.
